title: llms.txt Extractor input
description: Provide the list of domains to extract AI-agent policy files from. For each domain, /llms.txt, /agents.md, /ai.txt and /robots.txt are fetched and parsed into structured fields.

domains.title: Domains
domains.description: Domains (or URLs — only the origin is used), one per line. The scheme is optional: 'stripe.com' is treated as 'https://stripe.com'.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrency
maxConcurrency.description: How many domains to process in parallel. Each domain makes 4 lightweight HTTP requests.

fetchTimeoutSecs.title: Fetch timeout (seconds)
fetchTimeoutSecs.description: Per-request timeout. Domains where every request times out are reported as unreachable (and not charged).

includeRawContent.title: Include raw file contents
includeRawContent.description: When enabled, each dataset item also carries the raw text of every found file (up to 500 KB each). Leave off for compact, analysis-ready items.
includeRawContent.sectionDescription: Options most runs never need to touch.

userAgent.title: User-Agent override
userAgent.description: Optional custom User-Agent header. Leave empty for the default LlmsTxtExtractor UA.
